artifacts.enantiomorph:
Through the Bull's rut-drive, the lead-animals calved twelve grazing ranges, over each of which a triad of dominant beasts would patrol.³⁰ [*The full muster of thirty-six ranked animals and twelve grazing ranges is presented below with spoor-record.*]


**The Thirty-Six Ranked Animals:**


The scent-mark of the first is the grizzled stallion, who in coat looks as if he is dragging one haunch.³¹


The second is the Split-hoof, who is not one cleft, but two toes.³²


The third is the Bull himself.³³


The fourth is the Scapegoat.


The fifth is the Phantom-cat, but not the Phantom-cat returned from the ridgeline.³⁴


The sixth is the Musk-ox.


The fifth is the Carrion-fly.³⁵


The sixth is the Blind Sow.³⁶


The seventh is the Maned One.³⁷


The eighth is the Drone-bee.


The ninth is the Iridescent Mare.


The tenth is the Caged Parrot.


The eleventh is the Ram.


The twelfth is the Lead Dog.


The thirteenth is the Gut-shot Stag, but not the Gut-shot Stag walking again.


The fourteenth is the White Doe.


The fifteenth, the War-horse.³⁸


The sixteenth is the Herd-sovereign.


The seventeenth is the Fat Rooster.


The eighteenth is the Skull-capped Ape.


The nineteenth is the Plumage-display.³⁹


The twentieth is the Feral Tom.


The twenty-first is the Horned Owl.


The twenty-second is the Silver Serpent.⁴⁰


The twenty-third is the Litter.


The twenty-fourth is the Dun Mule.


The twenty-fifth is the Bone-gnawer.⁴¹


The twenty-sixth is the Bounded Pasture.


The twenty-seventh is the Nursing Bitch.⁴²


The twenty-eighth is the Caged Raptor.⁴³


The twenty-ninth is the Loping Hound.


The thirtieth is the Dusk-Moth Mare.


The thirty-first is the Horned Foal.


The thirty-second is the Elder Crow.⁴⁴


The thirty-third is the Alpha Wolf.


The thirty-fourth is the Mounting-error.⁴⁵


The thirty-fifth is the Breeding Organ.


And the thirty-sixth is the Albino Runt, who is set over the depths of the Burrow-network.⁴⁶


And the count of the nocturnal-diurnal cycles is 36.


**The Twelve Grazing Ranges:**


The loveliest is the Salt Lick, where the Bull himself does patrol


Then the Far Paddock


The Lean Season


The Fire-ring


The Antler-stand


The Red Dust Flat


The First-fruits Ground


The Enclosure


The Clearing


The Fasting Den


The Lambing Pen


And the Burrow-network⁴⁷


These are the twelve grazing ranges of beasts. A triad of dominant beasts stood over each, and through them the Bull stood over every herd.
